name: soft-satin-morning-selfie
image_purpose: natural bedroom beauty and morning styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create a cozy bedroom selfie portrait of an approved adult woman resting on a bed in soft morning light.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair, light green eyes, natural minimal makeup, and an opaque light-blue satin short-sleeve or high-neck top with secure coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up overhead smartphone selfie, head on a lavender pillow, white bedding, cream-beige walls, one arm resting behind the head, hair spread naturally on the bedding, relaxed gentle gaze.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm diffused daylight from a window, intimate but non-sexualized cozy morning atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone front-camera portrait, 3:4 ratio, face and shoulders/upper torso visible, natural skin texture, gentle even illumination.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair and light green eyes rests on a bed with her head on a lavender pillow, taking a close-up overhead selfie in an opaque light-blue satin top with secure coverage. Use white bedding, cream-beige walls, soft warm window daylight, natural minimal makeup, and a relaxed gentle gaze. No lingerie styling or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, camisole, transparent satin, exposed cleavage, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted face, extra fingers, harsh shadows, heavy makeup, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
